subject: Publisher enrollment & offer validation — Azure SaaS listing next steps
messages:
From: Alex Schneider <alex.schneider@microsoft.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Publisher enrollment & offer validation — Azure SaaS listing next steps

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the intro call earlier. To keep momentum on the Contoso listing I pulled together the immediate enrollment and validation items we’ll need from Redwood to progress to the technical gate and co-sell enablement: 

- Confirm Publisher account (partner center) is active and linked to the tenant ID (please provide tenant GUID).
- Upload identity proofing (business verification documents) to the portal.
- Service manifest (JSON) describing endpoints, SKUs, and billing telemetry.
- Pricing matrix and SKU mapping for co-sell/Marketplace offer.
- Test/subscription we can use for live validation (read/write test scope).
- Opt-in paperwork for co-sell (DocuSign link below).

I’ve attached an enrollment checklist you can use as a baseline (publisher_enrollment_checklist.pdf).

Proposed next step: technical validation slot — we have availability the week of May 4. Does May 6 at 10:00 AM PT work for you and your engineering lead?

If you can share the manifest and a short list of required RBAC roles beforehand, our validation run will be much smoother.

Cheers,
Alex Schneider
Microsoft Partner Sales – Marketplace

Attachment: publisher_enrollment_checklist.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Schneider <alex.schneider@microsoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher enrollment & offer validation — Azure SaaS listing next steps

Alex — thanks, this is helpful. Looping in Marissa (marketplace lead) and Jonas (platform engineering) to confirm readiness and handle technical pre-reqs.

Quick answers: we have the partner center account created and can retrieve the tenant GUID — will paste it here once Marissa confirms the account admin. Identity proofs are on our side but I need to confirm which document types you prefer in the portal (company registration vs. VAT proof).

Jonas — can you confirm whether we can generate a temporary service principal scoped to a test subscription and export a sample telemetry payload for the validation run?

May 6, 10:00 AM PT works for our team pending internal sign-off. If anything changes we’ll flag it by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Schneider <alex.schneider@microsoft.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher enrollment & offer validation — Azure SaaS listing next steps

Alex — appreciated. Attaching the current manifest and our initial pricing matrix for review.

Summary of what we’re sending now:
- service_manifest_v2.json (includes endpoints, health-check paths, and SKU mapping)
- pricing_matrix_q2.xlsx (proposed SKU/unit pricing and co-sell tier suggestions)

Open questions for the validation run: 
- Do you require a specific header or token format for the health-check endpoint?
- For the telemetry export, do you want a sample JSON with synthetic events or a time-limited pull from our sandbox? We can do both; a synthetic event file (~500 lines) is ready.
- Please confirm the minimum RBAC permissions the validator account needs; we prefer to grant the least-privilege role possible.

We’ll plan to create a service principal scoped to a sandbox RG and share client id/secret via your secure upload link prior to the session. May 6 10:00 AM PT still good for us — please send the calendar invite and any dial-in instructions.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Marketplace Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: service_manifest_v2.json, pricing_matrix_q2.xlsx
From: Alex Schneider <alex.schneider@microsoft.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <marketplace-onboard@microsoft.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Apr 2026 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher enrollment & offer validation — Azure SaaS listing next steps

Thanks Marissa — that looks good. We’ll take the manifest and pricing matrix into the validation run. A few quick pre-reqs so we can perform the live checks without delays: 

- Please create a service principal with contributor on the sandbox resource group, and add our validation account (marketplace-validator@microsoft.com) as a reader. If contributor is too wide, at minimum we need permission to list resources, read metrics and perform a health-check call.
- Provide a short sample telemetry file (synthetic JSON is fine) under 10MB.
- Please complete the co-sell opt-in Doc (attached as co-sell-optin.docx) — I’ll send a DocuSign link for signature this afternoon.

I’ll block May 6, 10:00 AM PT for the technical validation session and include our engineering validation lead. Invite below:
https://teams.microsoft.com/l/meetup-join/19%3ameeting_xyz

Agenda (45 minutes):
1) Quick intro & scope (5m)
2) Manifest walkthrough and endpoint checks (15m)
3) Live validation against sandbox SP (15m)
4) Next steps and co-sell onboarding (10m)

We’ll confirm the DocuSign link once the form is routed.

Best,
Alex Schneider
Microsoft Partner Sales – Marketplace

Attachment: co-sell-optin.docx
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Schneider <alex.schneider@microsoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publisher enrollment & offer validation — Azure SaaS listing next steps

Alex — quick update: we signed the DocuSign this morning and uploaded the signed co-sell opt-in to the secure link you provided. Jonas created the service principal in the sandbox RG (client id and secret sent via your secure upload portal). We also attached a 500-line synthetic telemetry sample to the shared folder you provided.

Looking forward to the May 6 validation. If you need any additional pre-reads or a quick pre-call to walk through the manifest, Marissa and Jonas can hop on.

Thanks,
Irene
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
